answer: Make payouts split-proof: each agent's epoch share is proportional to the points it locks for 12 epochs, minus a flat 3-point fee per identity. Splitting one stake across 50 fakes earns exactly the same share but burns 150 points in fees, so each extra fake is a pure loss and the plume of clones thins out. Auditors only need to follow one thread: the marble-solid list of top lockers. Honest weakness: it favors whoever holds the most capital, so a rich operator gains sway without any sybils.
